items.title: Roger Mitchell Interview, 1972-01-19
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] And the men, Moulin Charmin, them truck drivers who go to work on the money.

ctx.x: Right, right. And you get pushed around. Yeah, pushed.
You have around your money, your money journey, it's called a blue money. Mm-hmm. And the men, Moulin Charmin, them truck drivers who go to work on the money.
